title: StockSmart Training Note — Emergency Visit History and Outage Cover on a Converted Bin
content:
A program of the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program that has needed emergency visits holds more stock in a bin converted from consignment.

**Rule.** For the customer-owned fill-to level of a bin converted from consignment at a par review, emergency visits completed on the program in the last six months add outage cover: 3 or more add 1 week, 1 or 2 add 0.5 week, and none adds none.

**What is counted.** Every completed visit of the emergency kind on the program, whatever bin or item it served, in the last six months: rows of age below six, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

| Emergency visits completed in the last six months | Outage cover added |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 0.5 week |
| 2 | 0.5 week |
| 3 or more | 1 week |

**Hypothetical boundary.** 2 emergency visits add 0.5 week; a third in the window lifts the cover to 1 week.
